title: The Blood Furnace
body: The Blood Furnace lies within Hellfire Citadel, a wing of halls and cell blocks deep inside the fortress, and the Fel Horde keeps it well guarded. Shadowmoon warlocks, summoners and technicians tend it, arming bombs against intruders, while Laughing Skull enforcers, rogues and wardens stand watch and felguards and imps serve beside them. Orc captives fill its cells. In its chambers wait nascent fel orcs, new to their red skins and eager for blood, and through the halls the cry goes up that the blood is their power. A demon called the Maker works here undisturbed, the demon Broggok waits behind a barred gate, and in the deepest chamber Keli'dan the Breaker stands within a ring of channelers at a ritual of his own. Honor Hold and Thrallmar know only that something unnatural is at work in the furnace, and they mean to learn what it is.
sources: zones/blood_furnace.txt (map 542: area 3713 only)

title: The Maker
body: The Maker is a demon, one of the mo'arg, and he works among the fel orcs of the Blood Furnace as a craftsman works at his bench. He does not welcome visitors. His work, he warns, must not be interrupted, though he wonders aloud whether he might find a use for those who try, and he counts anger and hatred among the tools ready to his hand. To those who fall before him he makes a cold promise: he will see what he can make of them.

parts.body: The Maker fought to keep his work from interruption, bending the minds of his attackers against one another, and in the end it was interrupted for good. Dying, he could only gasp at them to stay away. Whatever he had been making in the Blood Furnace, he would make no more of it.

title: Broggok
body: Broggok is a demon kept behind a barred gate in the Blood Furnace, at the end of a hall of prison cells. The cells hold fel orcs, and a lever beside them opens their doors one after another. When the lever is pulled, Broggok calls the intruders on from behind its gate, and the cells loose one band after another on whoever stands in the hall. Only when the last band has fallen does the gate rise and Broggok come forth: a floating horror steeped in poison, which sprays venom and leaves clouds of it hanging in the air.

parts.body: Broggok died in the hall of cells, among the fel orcs who had been loosed before it, and the poison clouds it had raised faded with it. With Broggok dead, the way on toward the deeper chambers of the furnace lay open.

title: Keli'dan the Breaker
body: Keli'dan the Breaker holds the deepest chamber of the Blood Furnace. He is a fel orc sorcerer, and he does not stand guard so much as stand at work: in the middle of a ring of five Shadowmoon channelers he keeps a ritual burning, his whole attention bent on it, while they stand watch around him. What the ritual serves, no intruder is told. He will not turn from it lightly, and the channelers will let no one near him without a fight.

parts.body: When his channelers were cut down, Keli'dan broke from his ritual in a fury. Who dared interrupt, he demanded, and what had they done? They would ruin everything. He came at them wreathed in fire, crying for them to come closer and burn, and still he fell. He died with a bitter wish of good luck for his killers, who would need it.

title: The Blood is Life
body: The herald's letter has stirred up Honor Hold and Thrallmar alike. Both already fight the Burning Legion on their eastern flank, and now an army of new fel orcs gathers to the west, more of them all the time. If only they knew how those fel orcs were being made, they might find some way to stop it. So Gunny at Honor Hold and Caza'rez at Thrallmar send volunteers into what the fel orcs call the Blood Furnace, inside Hellfire Citadel, to kill fel orcs there and bring back vials of their blood.

parts.body: Gunny took the vials with delight, calling the one who brought them his favorite person on the sorry remains of this sorry planet. He was sure the scholars of Honor Hold would be thrilled to study the blood, and hoped they might find a new weapon in it against the fel orcs.
sources: quest 9589 reward text (favorite person on the sorry remains of this sorry planet; eggheads; maybe a new weapon against the fel orcs)

parts.body: Caza'rez was impressed: twice now the same volunteer had gone into Hellfire Citadel and come back with what was asked. He promised the blood would reach those who could unlock its mysteries, and hoped they might find a way to reverse what had been done to these orcs.

title: Heart of Rage
body: With the ramparts broken, Honor Hold and Thrallmar turn their scrying on the Blood Furnace, and what it shows them is troubling. Something unnatural is happening inside, but a power within blocks every attempt to look closer, which can only mean it matters a great deal. No mission sent into the furnace has ever come back. So the furnace must be scouted from end to end by a band strong enough to survive it, and whatever is found there reported straight to Force Commander Danath Trollbane, or to Nazgrel, advisor to Thrall.

parts.body: They have a pit lord. The commander's shout drew every eye in the room, and he dropped his voice to a whisper. The fel orcs must be made from this pit lord's blood, a new breed somehow not aligned with the Burning Legion, and what could be done to the brown orcs of Draenor could be done to any orc at all. The heart of their military might had to be struck, and soon.
